title: John Chrysostom on Deuteronomy 10:16
body: “For when the Gentiles," he says, "which have not the Law." What Law, say? The written one. "Do by nature the things of the Law." Of what Law?”
author: John Chrysostom, Homilies on Acts and Romans

title: John Chrysostom on Deuteronomy 18:15
body: “This may be viewed in two ways; it is either the law of grace which he speaks of, for he is wont to call this a law, as in the words, "For the law of the Spirit of life made me free:" (Rom.”
author: John Chrysostom, Homilies on Galatians through Philemon

title: John Chrysostom on Deuteronomy 22:5
body: “For if exchange of garments be not lawful, so that neither she should be clad with a cloak, nor he with a mantle or a veil: ("for the woman," saith He, "shall not wear that which pertaineth to a man, neither shall a man put on a woman's garments:") much more is it unseemly for these (Deut.”
author: John Chrysostom, Homilies on the Epistles to the Corinthians

title: John Chrysostom on Deuteronomy 23:1
body: “It is probable that this eunuch was an Ethiopian by birth and a Jewish proselyte. It was customary for such foreign proselytes, as well as for Jewish non-residents, to go up to Jerusalem to worship.”
author: John Chrysostom, Homilies on Acts and Romans

title: John Chrysostom on Deuteronomy 28:23
body: “A drought once overtook our city, and all were trembling for the last of evils, and were beseeching God to rid them of this fear. And one might see then that which was spoken of by Moses; (Deut.”
author: John Chrysostom, Homilies on the Epistles to the Corinthians

title: John Chrysostom on Deuteronomy 32:15
body: “But neither is the body, nor food, of the devil, but luxury alone. For by means of it that malignant fiend brings to pass his innumerable evils.”
author: John Chrysostom, Homilies on the Epistles to the Corinthians

title: John Chrysostom on Deuteronomy 32:21
body: “First Moses saith, I will provoke you to jealousy by them that are no people, and by a foolish nation I will anger you." (Deut.”
author: John Chrysostom, Homilies on Acts and Romans

title: Cyril of Jerusalem on Deuteronomy 33:2
body: “The following note is slightly abridged from the Edition of Alexandrides of Jerusalem. "Previous Editions read ex orous pharan kataskiou daseos.”
author: Cyril of Jerusalem, Catechetical Lectures
